legendary.desc: A 60-foot-radius aura of magical negative energy surrounds the mummy lord until the end of its next turn, spreading around corners. Creatures in the aura can't regain hit points.

legendary.name: Whirlwind of Sand
legendary.desc: The mummy lord, along with its equipment, magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand and moves up to 60 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, and then reverts to its normal form.

legendary.name: Attack
legendary.desc: The mummy lord uses Dreadful Glare or attacks with its rotting fist.

legendary.name: Blasphemous Word
legendary.desc: Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the mummy lord that can hear its magical imprecation makes a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is stunned until the end of the mummy lords next turn.

legendary.name: Dispel Magic
legendary.desc: The mummy lord casts dispel magic.

spells.name: Spellcasting
spells.list: The mummy lord is an 11th level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17 +9 to hit with spell attacks). The mummy lord has the following cleric spells prepared which it can cast without material components:  Cantrips: (at will): Guidance, Thaumaturgy 1st-Level: (4 slots): Create or Destroy Water, Detect Magic 2nd-Level: (3 slots): Augury, Gentle Repose 3rd-Level: (3 slots): Animate Dead, Dispel Magic 4th-Level: (3 slots): Divination, Guardian of Faith 5th-Level: (2 slots): Contagion 6th-Level: (1 slot): Harm

resources.name: Legendary Actions
resources.note: Pool; refills at the start of the monster's turn

name: Murmuring Worm
speed: 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., climb 40 ft., swim 40 ft.

special.name: Amphibious
special.desc: The worm can breathe air and water.

special.name: Locate Mind
special.desc: The worm is aware of the location and relative intelligence of all creatures with Intelligence scores greater than 3 within 500 feet.

special.name: Maddening Murmurs
special.desc: The worm babbles constantly. A non-aberrant creature that starts its turn within 30 feet and can hear its murmurs makes a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is confused until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The worm constricts once and attacks once with its bite.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained while grappled.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the target is killed by this attack  the worm eats its head.

actions.name: Mental Summons
actions.desc: One creature with an Intelligence score greater than 3 within 120 feet makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it uses its reaction to move up to its Speed towards the worm by the shortest route possible, avoiding hazards but not opportunity attacks. This is a magical charm effect.

special.name: Amphibious
special.desc: The naiad can breathe air and water.

special.name: Magic Resistance
special.desc: The naiad has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

special.name: Speak with Nature
special.desc: The naiad can communicate with beasts and plants.

actions.name: Watery Grasp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). While grappling a creature this way  the naiad can't use Watery Grasp on a different target and can swim at full speed.

name: Nalfeshnee
speed: 20 ft., climb 10 ft., fly 30 ft., swim 10 ft.
resist: cold, fire, lightning; damage from nonmagical weapons

special.name: Chaotic Evil
special.desc: The nalfeshnee radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

special.name: Magic Resistance
special.desc: The nalfeshnee has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee makes a bite attack and a claws attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) piercing damage. If it uses its bite on a dead  non-demon creature it regains 27 (5d10) hit points and recharges its Horror Nimbus. It may gain this benefit only once per creature.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Chaos Blast
actions.desc: Beams of multicolored light arc through a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 90 feet. Each creature in the area that does not have a Chaotic alignment makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw  taking 52 (8d12) force damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Horror Nimbus
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee glows with an unholy, multicolored radiance. Each creature within 15 feet of the nalfeshnee that can see it makes a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature is frightened for 1minute. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc: The nalfeshnee magically teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Bolt
actions.desc: (Cantrip; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d10) fire damage.

actions.name: Fireball
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S, M) Fire streaks from the mage to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Dimension Door
actions.desc: (4th-Level; V) The mage teleports to a location within 500 feet. They can bring along one willing Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. If a creature would teleport to an occupied space  it takes 14 (4d6) force damage  and the spell fails.

actions.name: Greater Invisibility
actions.desc: (4th-Level; V, S, Concentration) The mage or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 minute.

actions.name: Cone of Cold
actions.desc: (5th-Level; V, S, M) Frost blasts from the mage in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Misty Step
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V) The mage teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 30 feet. The mage can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.desc: (3rd-Level; S) When a creature the mage can see within 60 feet casts a spell, the mage attempts to interrupt it. If the creature is casting a 2nd-level spell or lower, the spell fails. If the creature is casting a 3rd-level or higher spell, the mage makes an Intelligence check against a DC of 10 + the spells level. On a success, the spell fails, and the spellcasting creature can use its reaction to try to cast a second spell with the same casting time so long as it uses a spell slot level equal to or less than half the original spell slot. If the mage casts counterspell with a higher spell slot, the interrupted spell fails if its level is less than that of counterspell.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.desc: (1st-Level; V) When the mage is hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile, they gain a +5 bonus to AC (including against the triggering attack) and immunity to magic missile. These benefits last until the start of their next turn.

spells.name: Spellcasting
spells.list: The mage is a 9th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14 +6 to hit with spell attacks). They have the following wizard spells prepared:  Cantrips: (at will): Fire Bolt, Light, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation 1st-Level: (4 slots): Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Armor, Shield 2nd-Level: (3 slots): Alter Self, Misty Step 3rd-Level: (3 slots): Animate Dead, Counterspell, Fireball 4th-Level: (3 slots): Dimension Door, Greater Invisibility 5th-Level: (1 slot): Cone of Cold

special.name: Curse
special.desc: A creature touched by the hags claws is magically cursed for 30 days. While under this curse, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls made against the hag.

special.name: Evil
special.desc: The hag radiates an Evil aura.

special.name: Magic Resistance
special.desc: The hag has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage  and the target is subject to the hags Curse trait.

actions.name: Sleep Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target falls asleep for 4 hours or until it takes damage or is shaken awake. Once the hag successfully hits a target  it can't make this attack again until it finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Shapeshift
actions.desc: The hag magically polymorphs into a Small or Medium humanoid. Equipment it is carrying isnt transformed. It retains its claws in any form. It has no true form and remains in its current form when it dies.

actions.name: Planar Travel
actions.desc: The hag magically enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane  or vice versa. Alternatively  the hag is magically transported to the Material Plane  Hell  or the Abyss  arriving within 10 miles of its desired destination.

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting
actions.desc: While on the Ethereal Plane  the hag magically touches a sleeping creature that is under the night hags Curse and is not protected by a magic circle or protection from evil and good spell or similar magic. As long as the touch persists  the target has terrible nightmares. If the nightmares last for 1 hour  the target gains no benefit from the rest  and its hit point maximum is reduced by 5 (1d10) until the curse ends. If this effect reduces the targets hit points maximum to 0  the target dies and the hag captures its soul. The reduction to the targets hit point maximum lasts until removed by greater restoration or similar magic.

name: Nightmare
speed: 60 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 90 ft., swim 30 ft.
languages: understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can't speak

special.name: Evil
special.desc: The nightmare radiates an Evil aura.

special.name: Fiery Hooves
special.desc: The nightmare sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The nightmare leaves charred hoofprints.

special.name: Fire Resistance
special.desc: The nightmare can grant fire resistance to a rider.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the horse moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure. The nightmare can move through the space of a prone creature as long as it does not end its turn there.

actions.name: Ethereal Shift
actions.desc: The nightmare and a rider magically pass from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane or vice versa.

special.name: Opposite Nature
special.desc: Normal damage heals the nilbogfor the amount done. Nilbogs can only be harmed/damaged by healing magic. Their skin resists all otherforms of harm. Potions of healing deal acid damage toa nilbog equal to the amount of hit points they wouldnormally heal, and spells that restore hit pointsinstead deal necrotic damage.

actions.name: Rat flail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (3d4 + 1) bludgeoning or piercing damage.

actions.name: Fetid sling
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3(1d6) bludgeoning damage  and the target must make a DC 14 Constitutionsaving throw. On a failure  the target is poisoned for 1minute.

actions.name: Nimble Escape
actions.desc: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

name: Noble
skills: Deception +4, History +2, Insight +3, Intimidation +4, Performance +4, Persuasion +4

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: If the noble is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

name: Ochre Jelly
condImmune: blinded, charmed, deafened, fatigue, frightened, prone

special.name: Amorphous
special.desc: The jelly can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

special.name: Ooze Nature
special.desc: An ooze doesnt require air or sleep.

special.name: Spider Climb
special.desc: The jelly can use its climb speed even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

special.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special.desc: While in sunlight, the jelly has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). A grappled target takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of the jellys turns.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.desc: When a Medium or larger jelly with at least 10 hit points is subjected to lightning or slashing damage, it splits into two jellies that are each one size smaller, freeing any grappled targets. Each new jelly has half the originals hit points (rounded down).

special.name: Camouflage
special.desc: The octopus has advantage on Stealth checks.

special.name: Water Breathing
special.desc: The octopus breathes water and can hold its breath for 30 minutes while in air.

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 1 bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 10). Until this grapple ends  the target is restrained  and the octopus can't attack a different target with its tentacles.

actions.name: Ink Cloud
actions.desc: If underwater, the octopus exudes a cloud of ink in a 5-foot-radius sphere, extending around corners. The area is heavily obscured for 1 minute unless dispersed by a strong current.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Sweeping Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.  all creatures within 5 feet. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 10 feet away from the ogre.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

special.name: Undead Fortitude (1/Day)
special.desc: If the zombie is reduced to 0 hit points by damage that isnt radiant or from a critical hit, its instead reduced to 1 hit point, falls prone, and is stunned until the end of its next turn, appearing to be dead.

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A zombie doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Sweeping Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.  all creatures within 5 feet. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 10 feet away from the ogre.

actions.name: Grab
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled if its Medium or smaller (escape DC 14)  and until the grapple ends  the zombie can't grab another target.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target grappled by a zombie. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage  and the zombie regains hit points equal to the damage dealt

reactions.name: Bodyblock
reactions.desc: If the ogre flesh heap is grappling a creature when it is hit with a weapon attack by a creature it can see, it uses the creature as a shield, adding 2 to its AC against the attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the attack hits the grappled creature instead.

reactions.name: Corpulent Expulsion
reactions.desc: When it takes damage, the ogre flesh heaps belly splits and releases a torrent of caustic gore in a 30-foot cone. Creatures in this area make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) acid damage on a failure and half damage on a success. The flesh heap then takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.

name: Ogre Mage
speed: 30 ft., climb 15 ft., fly 30 ft., swim 15 ft.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ogre makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Iron Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage  or 10 (1d12 + 4) bludgeoning damage in Small or Medium form. When the ogre hits or touches a target with its club  it can end any spell on the target that was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot.

actions.name: Read Scroll
actions.desc: The ogre casts a spell from a magical scroll without expending the scrolls magic.

actions.name: Darkness
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) Magical darkness spreads from a point within 30 feet of the ogre  filling a 15-foot-radius sphere and spreading around corners. It remains for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness  and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

actions.name: Hold Person
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) One humanoid the ogre can see within 60 feet makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is paralyzed for 1 minute  repeating the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) The ogre is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the ogre attacks or casts a spell.

actions.name: Gaseous Form
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S, Concentration) The ogre and its gear becomes a hovering cloud of gas for 1 hour. Its Speed is 0  and its fly speed is 30. It can't attack  use or drop objects  talk  or cast spells. It can enter another creatures space and pass through small holes and cracks but can't pass through liquid. It is resistant to nonmagical damage  has advantage on Strength  Dexterity and Constitution saving throws  and can't fall.

actions.name: Cone of Cold
actions.desc: (5th-Level; V, S) Frost blasts from the ogre in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw  taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Shapeshift
actions.desc: The ogre changes its form into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form, which is a Large giant. Other than its size, its statistics are the same in each form. Its iron club, armor, and clothing change size with it. It reverts to its true form when it dies.

spells.name: Innate Spellcasting
spells.list: The ogres innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:  At Will: Darkness, Invisibility 1/Day: Charm Person, Cone of Cold, Gaseous Form, Hold Person

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A zombie doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Grab

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target grappled by a zombie. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage  and the zombie regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

special.name: Giant Build
special.desc: The ogrekin counts as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift. Its melee and thrown weapons deal an extra die of damage on a hit (included below).

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.

name: Orcish Wildling Minstrel
skills: Deception +5, History +3, Nature +3, Performance +5, Persuasion +5, Survival +3

special.name: Legend lore
special.desc: Once every 30 days, the orcish wilding minstrel can innately cast Legend Lore with no material component.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Vicious Mockery
actions.desc: (Cantrip; V) A creature within 60 feet that can hear the minstrel makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage and has disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) The minstrel or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the invisible creature attacks or casts a spell.

actions.name: Shatter
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, M) An ear-splitting ringing sound fills a 10-foot-radius sphere emanating from a point the minstrel can see within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw  taking 13 (3d8) thunder damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. A creature made of stone  metal  or other inorganic material has disadvantage on its saving throw. Unattended objects in the area also take the damage.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pattern
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; S, M, Concentration) A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

actions.name: Martial Encouragement
actions.desc: Until the beginning of the minstrels next turn, one creature within 30 feet that can hear the minstrel deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage whenever it deals weapon damage.

actions.name: Healing Word
actions.desc: (1st-Level; V) The minstrel or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The minstrel can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

actions.name: Many orc tribes use song to preserve a communal memory of history
actions.desc: Minstrels are the keepers of the tribes wisdom and identity.

spells.name: Spellcasting
spells.list: The minstrel is a 5th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13 +5to hit with spell attacks). They have the following bard spells prepared:  Cantrips: (at will): Light, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, vicious mockery 1st-Level: (4 slots): Charm Person, Disguise Self, Healing Word 2nd-Level: (3 slots): enthrall, Invisibility, shatter 3rd-Level: (2 slots): Hypnotic Pattern, Major Image

special.name: Bloodied Frenzy
special.desc: While the berserker is bloodied, they make all attacks with advantage and all attacks against them are made with advantage.

special.name: Unarmored Defense
special.desc: The berserkers AC equals 10 + their Dexterity modifier + their Constitution modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The berserker attacks twice.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d12 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Aggressive Charge
actions.desc: The urk moves up to their Speed towards an enemy they can see or hear.

actions.name: Warriors who fight on the front lines of an orc war horde gain a special title: urk, meaning doomed
actions.desc: Other orc warriors treat urks with the deference due the sacred nature of their rage and sacrifice.

name: Otyugh
languages: telepathy 120 ft. (can transmit but not receive thoughts and images)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. The otyugh has two tentacles  each of which can grapple one target and can't attack a different target while doing so.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: The otyugh slams any creatures it is grappling into a hard surface or into each other. Each creature makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  is stunned until the end of the otyughs next turn  and is pulled up to 5 feet towards the otyugh. On a success  the target takes half damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target contracts a disease. While diseased, the target is poisoned. The target repeats the saving throw every 24 hours, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure (to a minimum of 1 hit point) and becoming cured on a success. The reduction in hit points lasts until the disease is cured.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: If the otyugh has no other creature in its stomach, the otyugh bites a Medium or smaller creature that is stunned. On a hit, the creature is swallowed. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the otyugh, is blinded and restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the otyugh's turns. If a swallowed creature deals 15 or more damage to the otyugh in a single turn, or if the otyugh dies, the otyugh vomits up the creature.

name: Owl
speed: 5 ft., climb 2 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 2 ft.

special.name: Flyby
special.desc: The owl doesnt provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of a creatures reach.

special.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
special.desc: The owl has advantage on Perception checks that rely on hearing and sight.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 slashing damage. If this damage would reduce a Small or larger target to 0 hit points  the target takes no damage from this attack.

special.name: Keen Sight and Smell
special.desc: The owlbear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight or smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The owlbear attacks with its beak and claws.

actions.name: Beak

special.desc: While in sunlight, the drider has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Perception checks that rely on sight.

special.name: Web Walker
special.desc: The drider ignores movement restrictions imposed by webs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The drider makes a claws attack and then either a bite or longsword attack. Alternatively  it makes two longbow attacks.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). While grappling a target  the drider can't attack a different target with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one grappled creature. Hit: 2 (1d4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 120/600 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Darkness
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) Magical darkness spreads from a point within 30 feet  filling a 15-foot-radius sphere and spreading around corners. It remains for 1 minute. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

actions.name: Web
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, Concentration) Thick  sticky webs fill a 20-foot cube within 60 feet  lightly obscuring it and making it difficult terrain. The webs must either be anchored between two solid masses (such as walls) or layered 5 feet deep over a flat surface. Each creature that starts its turn in the webs or that enters them during its turn makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  it is restrained. A creature can escape by using an action to make a DC 14 Strength check. Any 5-foot cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round  dealing 5 (2d4) fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire. The webs remain for 1 minute.

actions.name: Longsword (wielded two-handed)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.

spells.name: Innate Spellcasting
spells.list: The driders innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14). The drider can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:  At Will: dancing lights, 1/Day Each: Darkness, Web

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target is poisoned for 1 hour. If it fails the saving throw by 5 or more  it falls unconscious until it is no longer poisoned  it takes damage  or a creature takes an action to shake it awake.

spells.name: Shadow Elf Spellcasting
spells.list: The warriors spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12). The warrior can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:  At Will: Dancing Lights 1/Day Each: Darkness, Faerie Fire

special.name: Lightning Absorption
special.desc: When the shambling mound would be subjected to lightning damage, it instead regains hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shambling mound takes two slam attacks. If both attacks hit one Medium or smaller creature  the target is grappled (escape DC 15)  and the shambling mound uses Engulf against it.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: The shambling mound absorbs a Medium or smaller grappled creature into its body. The engulfed creature is blinded  restrained can't breathe  and moves with the shambling mound. At the start of each of the shambling mounds turns  the target takes 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands all languages but can't speak
condImmune: charmed, fatigue, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

special.name: Amulet
special.desc: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. It knows the distance and direction to the amulet while it is on the same plane of existence. Whoever wears the amulet becomes the guardians master and can magically command the guardian to travel to it.

special.name: Constructed Nature
special.desc: Guardians dont require air, sustenance, or sleep.

special.name: Immutable Form
special.desc: The guardian is immune to any effect that would alter its form.

special.name: Magic Resistance
special.desc: The guardian has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

special.name: Spell Storing
special.desc: A spellcaster wearing the guardians amulet can use the guardian to store a spell. The spellcaster casts a spell using a 4th-level or lower spell slot on the guardian, choosing any spell parameters. The spell has no effect when thus cast. The guardian can cast this spell once, using no components, when ordered to do so by its master or under other predefined circumstances. When a spell is stored in the guardian, any previously stored spell is lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The guardian attacks twice with its fist.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Self-Repair
actions.desc: The guardian regains 15 hit points.

reactions.name: Absorb Damage
reactions.desc: If the guardian is within 60 feet of its master when the master takes damage, half the damage (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.desc: If the guardian is within 5 feet of its master when the master is attacked, the guardian grants a +3 bonus to its masters AC.

name: Shrieker
condImmune: blinded, charmed, deafened, fatigue, frightened, prone, restrained, stunned

special.name: False Appearance
special.desc: While motionless, the shrieker is indistinguishable from a normal fungus.

reactions.name: Shriek
reactions.desc: If the shrieker perceives a creature within 30 feet  or if an area of bright light is within 30 feet  it shrieks loudly and continuously. The shriek is audible within 300 feet. The shrieker continues to shriek for 1 minute after the creature or light has moved away.

special.name: Aquatic
special.desc: The shroud ray can only breathe underwater.

special.name: False Appearance
special.desc: When motionless, the ray is indistinguishable from a patch of sand.

special.name: Light Sensitivity
special.desc: The cloaker has disadvantage on attack rolls and Perception checks while in bright light.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 15). If the cloaker has advantage against the target  the cloaker attaches to the targets head  and the target is blinded and suffocating. Until this grapple ends  the cloaker automatically hits the grappled creature with this attack. When the cloaker is dealt damage while grappling  it takes half the damage (rounded down) and the other half is dealt to the grappled target. The cloaker can have only one creature grappled at once.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage  and the creature makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned until the end of the cloakers next turn.

actions.name: Moan
actions.desc: Each non-aberration creature within 60 feet that can hear its moan makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened until the end of the cloakers next turn. When a creature succeeds on this saving throw  it becomes immune to the cloakers moan for 24 hours.

actions.name: Phantasms
actions.desc: The cloaker magically creates flickering illusions of itself in its space. Attacks on it have disadvantage. This effect ends after 1 minute  when the cloaker enters an area of bright light  or when it successfully grapples a creature.

reactions.name: Reactive Tail
reactions.desc: When hit or missed with a melee attack, the cloaker makes a tail attack against the attacker.

reactions.name: Angry Moan
reactions.desc: When the cloaker takes damage, it uses Moan.

name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
speed: 30 ft., climb 15 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 15 ft.

special.name: Cloud Strider
special.desc: The dragon suffers no harmful effects from high altitude.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons
actions.desc: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons:

actions.name: Frost Breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales freezing wind in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw  taking 17 (5d6) cold damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.desc: The dragon exhales paralytic gas in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

special.name: Amphibious
special.desc: The sirencan breathe and sing both in air and underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The harpy attacks twice with its claw.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Luring Song
actions.desc: The harpy sings a magical song. Each humanoid and giant within 300 feet that can hear it makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature becomes charmed until the harpy fails to use its bonus action to continue the song. While charmed by the harpy, a creature is incapacitated and ignores other harpy songs. On each of its turns, the creature moves towards the harpy by the most direct route, not avoiding opportunity attacks or hazards. The creature repeats its saving throw whenever it is damaged and before it enters damaging terrain such as lava. If a saving throw is successful or the effect ends on it, it is immune to any harpys song for the next 24 hours.

name: Skeletal Champion
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A skeleton doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeleton makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Shielding Riposte
reactions.desc: When a creature within the skeletons reach misses with a melee attack against the skeleton or a creature within 5 feet, the skeleton makes a longsword attack against the attacker. The skeleton must be wielding a longsword to use this reaction.

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A skeleton doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeleton makes a bite attack and a tail attack against two different targets.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends  the skeleton can't bite a different creature and it has advantage on bite attacks against the grappled creature.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A skeleton doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the skeleton moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

name: Skeleton
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A skeleton doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Skeleton Horde
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A skeleton doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d6 + 10) piercing damage  or half damage if the horde is bloodied.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d6 + 10) piercing damage  or half damage if the horde is bloodied.

special.name: Chaotic Evil
special.desc: The lamia radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

actions.name: Dizzying Touch
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: The target is magically charmed for 1 hour or until it takes damage. While charmed in this way  it has disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws and ability checks.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends  the lamia can't constrict a different target.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 hour.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pattern
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; S, Concentration) A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

actions.name: Misty Step
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V) The lamia teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. The lamia can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

spells.name: Innate Spellcasting
spells.list: The lamias innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components.  At Will: Charm Person, Disguise Self (humanoid form), Major Image, Misty Step 1/Day Each: Geas, Hallucinatory Terrain, Hypnotic Pattern, Scrying

name: Solar
speed: 50 ft., climb 25 ft., fly 150 ft., swim 25 ft.

special.name: Champion of Truth
special.desc: The solar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The solar attacks twice with its holy sword.

actions.name: Holy Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Column of Flame
actions.desc: Flame erupts in a 10-foot-radius  30-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point the solar can see within 60 feet of it. Each creature in the area makes a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage and 21 (6d6) radiant damage of a failure  or half as much damage on a success.

reactions.name: Forceful Parry
reactions.desc: When a creature misses the solar with a melee attack, the solars parrying sword sparks with energy. The attacker takes 21 (6d6) lightning damage and makes a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is pushed 10 feet away and falls prone.

legendary.name: The solar can take 3 legendary actions
legendary.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. The solar regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Teleport
legendary.desc: The solar magically teleports up to 120 feet to an empty space it can see.

legendary.name: Heal
legendary.desc: The solar touches a creature other than itself, magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness, curse, deafness, disease, or poison on the target.

legendary.name: Deafening Command
legendary.desc: The solar speaks an echoing command. Each creature of the solars choice within 30 feet that can hear the solar and understands a language makes a DC 24 Charisma saving throw. Each creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage. Each creature that fails its saving throw immediately takes a certain action, depending on the solars command. This is a magical charm effect.

legendary.name: Abase yourself! The creature falls prone
Approach! The creature must use its reaction
Flee! The creature must use its reaction
Surrender! The creature drops anything it is holding

spells.name: Innate Spellcasting
spells.list: The solars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 25). The solar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: 1/Day Each: Commune, Control Weather, Resurrection

resources.name: Legendary Actions
resources.note: Pool; refills at the start of the monster's turn

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage  or 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage if within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Tactical Movement
actions.desc: Until the end of the soldiers turn, their Speed is halved and their movement doesnt provoke opportunity attacks.

special.name: Area Vulnerability
special.desc: The squad takes double damage from any effect that targets an area.

special.name: Squad
special.desc: The squad is composed of 5 or more soldiers. If it is subjected to a spell, attack, or other effect that affects only one target, it takes any damage but ignores other effects. It can share its space with Medium or smaller creatures or objects. The squad can move through any opening large enough for one Medium creature without squeezing.

special.name: Squad Dispersal
special.desc: When the squad is reduced to 0 hit points, it turns into 2 (1d4) soldiers with 9 hit points each.

actions.name: Spears
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d6 + 10) piercing damage  or half damage if the squad is bloodied.

actions.name: Tactical Movement
actions.desc: Until the end of the squads turn, their Speed is halved and their movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Spark Mephit
speed: 30 ft., climb 15 ft., fly 30 ft., swim 15 ft.

special.name: Death Burst
special.desc: When the mephit dies, its Spark Form recharges, and the mephit uses it before it dies.

special.name: Elemental Nature
special.desc: A mephit doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

actions.name: Spark Form
actions.desc: The mephit transforms into an arc of lightning and flies up to 20 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement  the mephit can pass through other creatures spaces. Whenever it moves through another creatures space for the first time during this movement  that creature makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 5 (2d4) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success. The mephit then reverts to its original form.

actions.name: Faerie Flame
actions.desc: Each creature within 10 feet of the mephit makes a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  the creature is magically outlined in blue light for 1 minute. While outlined  the creature gains no benefit from being invisible and attack rolls against it are made with advantage.

name: Specter
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak
resist: acid, cold, fire, lighting, thunder; damage from nonmagical weapons
condImmune: charmed, fatigue, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

special.name: Incorporeal
special.desc: The specter can move through creatures and objects. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object. If it takes radiant damage, it loses this trait until the end of its next turn.

special.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special.desc: While in sunlight, the specter has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Perception checks that rely on sight.

special.name: Undead Nature
special.desc: A specter doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) necrotic damage  and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Hurl
actions.desc: The specter targets a Medium or smaller creature  or an object weighing no more than 150 pounds  within 30 feet of it. A creature makes a DC 12 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is hurled up to 30 feet in any direction (including upwards)  taking 3 (1d6) damage for every 10 feet it is hurled. An object is launched up to 30 feet in a straight line  and a creature in its path makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure. On a success  the creature takes no damage  and the object keeps flying past it.

actions.name: Fade
actions.desc: While not in sunlight  the specter turns invisible and takes the Hide action. It remains invisible for 1 minute or until it uses Life Drain or takes damage. If the specter takes radiant damage  it can't use this action until the end of its next turn.

name: Spell-warped Chuul
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak

special.name: Absorb Magic
special.desc: The chuul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. Whenever the chuul successfully saves against a spell or magical effect, it magically gains 5 (1d10) temporary hit points. While these temporary hit points last, the chuuls pincer attacks deal an additional 3 (1d6) force damage.

special.name: Amphibious
special.desc: The chuul can breathe air and water.

special.name: Detect Magic
special.desc: The chuul senses a magical aura around any visible creature or object within 120 feet that bears magic.

special.name: King-Sized Claw
special.desc: One of the chuuls pincers deals 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage on a successful hit. A creature grappled by this pincer makes ability checks to escape the grapple with disadvantage.

special.name: Rune Drinker
special.desc: Whenever the chuul takes damage from a magic weapon, until the start of the chuuls next turn attacks made with that weapon have disadvantage, and the chuul gains a +4 bonus to AC.

special.name: Sparking Wand
special.desc: A wand of lightning bolts adorns the chuuls carapace. A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet must make a successful DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 7 (2d6) lightning damage. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the chuul can grab the wand by making a successful DC 14 Athletics or Sleight of Hand check. A creature that fails this check must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isnt knocked prone.

special.name: Spell-warped
special.desc: The spell-warped Chuul possesses one of the following traits.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: If the chuul is grappling a creature  it uses its tentacle on that creature. It then makes two pincer attacks.

actions.name: Pincer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Large or smaller target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). When carrying a grappled creature  the chuul can move at full speed. A pincer that is being used to grapple a creature can be used only to attack that creature.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.desc: A grappled creature makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is paralyzed for 1 minute. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the paralysis on a success.

name: Sphinx
speed: 40 ft., climb 20 ft., fly 60 ft., swim 20 ft.

special.name: Inscrutable
special.desc: The sphinx is immune to divination and to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts. Insight checks made to determine the sphinxs intentions are made with disadvantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx attacks twice with its claw.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dispel Magic
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S) The sphinx scours the magic from one creature  object  or magical effect within 120 feet that it can see. A spell ends if it was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot. For spells using a 4th-level or higher spell slot  the sphinx makes a Wisdom ability check (DC 10 + the spells level) for each one  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Flame Strike
actions.desc: (5th-Level; V, S) A column of divine flame fills a 10-foot-radius  40-foot-high cylinder within 60 feet. Creatures in the area make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Speed Time
actions.desc: For 1 minute, the sphinxs Speed and flying speed are doubled, opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage, and it can attack three times with its claw (instead of twice) when it uses Multiattack.

actions.name: Planar Jaunt
actions.desc: The sphinx targets up to eight willing creatures it can see within 300 feet. The targets are magically transported to a different place, plane of existence, demiplane, or time. This effect ends after 24 hours or when the sphinx takes a bonus action to end it. When the effect ends, the creatures reappear in their original locations, along with any items they acquired on their jaunt. While the effect lasts, the sphinx can communicate telepathically with the targets. The sphinx chooses one of the following destinations:

actions.name: Different Location or Plane of Existence
actions.desc: The creatures appear in empty spaces of the sphinxs choice anywhere on the Material Plane or on a different plane altogether.

actions.name: Demiplane
actions.desc: The creatures appear in empty spaces of the sphinxs choice on a demiplane. The demiplane can be up to one square mile in size. The demiplane can appear to be inside, outside, or underground, and can contain terrain, nonmagical objects, and magical effects of the sphinxs choosing. The sphinx may populate it with creatures and hazards with a total Challenge Rating equal to or less than the sphinxs Challenge Rating.

actions.name: Time
actions.desc: The creatures appear in empty spaces of the sphinxs choosing anywhere on the Material Plane, at any time from 1,000 years in the past to 1,000 years in the future. At the Narrators discretion, changes made in the past may alter the present.

spells.name: Innate Spellcasting
spells.list: The sphinxs spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18). It can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:  At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Minor Illusion, Spare the Dying 3/Day Each: Dispel Magic, Identify, Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse, Scrying, Tongues, Zone of Truth 1/Day Each: contact other plane, Flame Strike, Freedom of Movement, Greater Restoration, Legend Lore, Heroes Feast

special.name: Spider Climb
special.desc: The spider can climb even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

special.name: Web Sense
special.desc: While touching a web, the spider knows the location of other creatures touching that web.

special.name: Web Walker
special.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions imposed by webs.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage and the target makes a DC 9 Constitution saving throw  taking 2 (1d4) poison damage on a failure.

special.name: Amphibious
special.desc: The naga can breathe air and water.

special.name: Rejuvenation
special.desc: If it dies, the naga gains a new body in 1d6 days, regaining all its hit points. This trait can be removed with a wish spell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Hypnotic Pattern
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, Concentration) A swirling pattern of light appears at a point within 120 feet of the naga. Each creature within 10 feet of the pattern that can see it makes a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the creature is charmed for 1 minute. While charmed  the creature is incapacitated and its Speed is 0. The effect ends on a creature if it takes damage or if another creature uses an action to shake it out of its daze.

legendary.name: Roar
legendary.desc: Each creature of the tarrasques choice within 120 feet makes a DC 19 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened for 1 minute. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of its turns, with disadvantage if the tarrasque is in line of sight, ending the effect on itself on a success. If it succeeds on a saving throw or the effect ends on it, it is immune to the tarrasques Roar for 24 hours.

legendary.name: Elite Recovery
legendary.desc: The tarrasque ends one negative effect currently affecting it. It can use this action as long as it has at least 1 hit point, even while unconscious or incapacitated.

legendary.name: Chomp
legendary.desc: The tarrasque makes a bite attack or uses Swallow.

legendary.name: Inescapable Earth
legendary.desc: Each flying creature or object within 300 feet falls and its flying speed is reduced to 0 until the start of the tarrasques next turn.

resources.note: Pool; refills at the start of the monster's turn

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The thug attacks twice with their brass knuckles.

actions.name: Brass Knuckles
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  it is unconscious and stable.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100/400 feet  one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Thunderbird
speed: 30 ft., climb 15 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 15 ft.

special.name: Keen Sight
special.desc: The griffon has advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight.

special.name: Storm Sight
special.desc: A thunderbirds vision is not limited by weather.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The griffon attacks once with its beak and once with its talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage  or 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage if the griffon started its turn at least 20 feet above the target  and the target is grappled (escape DC 14). Until this grapple ends  the griffon can't attack a different target with its talons.

actions.name: Lightning Strike
actions.desc: The thunderbird exhales a blast of lightning at one target within 60 feet. The target makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half the damage on a success.

special.name: Keen Smell
special.desc: The tiger has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8+3) slashing damage. If the tiger moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target makes a DC 13 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Opportune Bite
actions.desc: The tiger makes a bite attack against a prone creature.

special.name: Amphibious
special.desc: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

special.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
special.desc: If the dragon turtle fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, the faint glow cast by its shell winks out. When the dragon turtle uses Retract, it gains one more use of this ability and its shell regains its luminescence.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 52 (7d12 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 21). Until this grapple ends  the dragon turtle can't bite a different creature  and it has advantage on bite attacks against the grappled creature.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 46 (6d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. This attack deals double damage against objects  vehicles  and constructs.

actions.name: Steam Breath
actions.desc: The dragon turtle exhales steam in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw  taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Retract
reactions.desc: When the dragon turtle takes 50 damage or more from a single attack or spell, it retracts its head and limbs into its shell. It immediately regains 20 hit points. While retracted, it is blinded; its Speed is 0; it can't take reactions; it has advantage on saving throws; attacks against it have disadvantage; and it has resistance to all damage. The dragon turtle stays retracted until the beginning of its next turn.

reactions.name: Tail
reactions.desc: When the dragon turtle is hit by an opportunity attack, it makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: The dragon turtle can take 3 legendary actions
legendary.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Claw Kick
legendary.desc: The dragon turtle makes a claws attack and then moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Emerald Radiance
legendary.desc: Searing green light emanates from the dragon turtle. Each creature within 90 feet makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) radiant damage on a failure or half damage on a success. A creature that fails the saving throw is blinded until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Lightning Storm
legendary.desc: The dragon turtle recharges and uses Lightning Storm.

legendary.name: Tail
legendary.desc: The dragon turtle makes a tail attack.

spells.list: 3/Day Each: Control Weather, Water Breathing, Zone of Truth

name: Titanic Kraken
languages: understands Primordial but can't speak, telepathy 120 ft.

special.name: Bloodied Ichor
special.desc: While the Kraken is bloodied and in the water, black ichor leaks from it in a 60-foot radius, spreading around corners but not leaving the water. The area is lightly obscured to all creatures except the Kraken. A creature that starts its turn in the area takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.

special.name: Immortal Nature
special.desc: The kraken doesnt require air, sustenance, or sleep.

special.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special.desc: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it can use its reaction, if available, to attack with its tentacle.

special.name: Magic Resistance
special.desc: The kraken has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

special.name: Siege Monster
special.desc: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature grappled by the kraken  the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained  its Speed is 0  it has total cover from attacks from outside the kraken  and it takes 42 (12d6) acid damage at the start of each of the krakens turns.

actions.name: If a swallowed creature deals 50 or more damage to the kraken in a single turn, or if the kraken dies, the kraken vomits up the creature
Ink Cloud
actions.desc: While underwater  the kraken exudes a cloud of ink in a 90-foot-radius sphere. The ink extends around corners  and the area is heavily obscured until the end of the krakens next turn or until a strong current dissipates the cloud. Each non-kraken creature in the area when the cloud appears makes a DC 24 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it takes 27 (5d10) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success  it takes half damage. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Summon Storm
actions.desc: Over the next 10 minutes  storm clouds magically gather. At the end of 10 minutes  a storm rages for 1 hour in a 5-mile radius.

actions.name: Lightning
actions.desc: If the kraken is outside and the weather is stormy  three lightning bolts crack down from the sky  each of which strikes a different target within 120 feet of the kraken. A target makes a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw  taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage or half damage on a save.

legendary.name: The kraken can take 3 legendary actions
legendary.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Tentacle
legendary.desc: The kraken makes one tentacle attack.

legendary.name: Fling
legendary.desc: The kraken uses Fling.

legendary.name: Squeeze
legendary.desc: The kraken ends any magical effect that is restraining it or reducing its movement and then swims up to half its swim speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During this movement, it can fit through gaps as narrow as 10 feet wide without squeezing.

special.name: False Appearance
special.desc: While motionless, the treant is indistinguishable from a tree.

special.name: Flammable
special.desc: If the treant takes fire damage, it catches fire, taking 10 (3d6) ongoing fire damage, unless it is already on fire. It can use an action to extinguish itself, ending the ongoing damage.

special.name: Forest Speaker
special.desc: The treant can communicate with beasts and plants.

special.name: Siege Monster
special.desc: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The treant makes two attacks  or makes one attack and uses Animate Plant.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Animate Plant
actions.desc: The treant magically animates a Large or larger plant within 60 feet. The plant is immobile  but it acts on the treants initiative and can make slam attacks  or rock attacks if there are rocks to throw within 10 feet of it. Non-plant creatures treat the ground within 15 feet of the plant as difficult terrain  as surrounding roots conspire to trip and grasp moving creatures. The plant remains animated for 1 hour. If the treant uses this action while it has three plants animated in this way  the plant that has been animated the longest returns to normal.

actions.name: Defensive Gore
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 5) piercing damage  and the target has disadvantage on the next attack it makes against the triceratops before the end of the triceratopss next turn.

actions.name: Trample
actions.desc: The triceratops moves up to its speed in a straight line. It can move through the spaces of Large and smaller creatures. Each of these creatures makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage on a failure.

name: Trickster Priest
skills: Deception +3, Insight +5, Medicine +5, Persuasion +3, Religion +3, Stealth +2

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. On a hit  the priest can expend a spell slot to deal 7 (2d6) radiant damage  plus an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage for each level of the spell slot expended above 1st.

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.desc: (Cantrip; V, S) One creature the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw  taking 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: (2nd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) The priest or a creature they touch is invisible for 1 hour. The spell ends if the invisible creature attacks or casts a spell.

actions.name: Spirit Guardians
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) Spectral forms surround the priest in a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes. The priest can choose creatures they can see to be unaffected by the spell. Other creatures treat the area as difficult terrain  and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there  it makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) radiant or necrotic damage (priests choice) on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Healing Word
actions.desc: (1st-Level; V) The priest or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The priest can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

spells.name: Spellcasting
spells.list: The priest is a 5th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13 +5to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:  Cantrips: (at will): Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy, Minor Illusion 1st-Level: (4 slots): Ceremony, Detect Evil and Good, Healing Word, Disguise Self 2nd-Level: (3 slots): Lesser Restoration, Invisibility 3rd-Level: (2 slots): Spirit Guardians, Major Image

special.name: Stench
special.desc: A non-troglodyte that starts its turn within 5 feet of the troglodyte makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is immune to a troglodytes Stench for 24 hours.

special.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special.desc: While in sunlight, the troglodyte has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Perception checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troglodyte attacks with its bite and its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is infected with Troglodyte Stench.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

special.name: 1-4: Arm
special.desc: If the troll has an arm, it loses an arm. It loses one of its claw attacks, and the severed arm can make a claw attack.

special.name: 5-6: Head
special.desc: If the troll has a head, it loses its head. It loses its bite attack, and the severed head can make a bite attack.

special.name: Keen Smell
special.desc: The troll has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

special.name: Regeneration
special.desc: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesnt function on its next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesnt regenerate.

special.name: Severed Limbs
special.desc: If the troll is dealt a critical hit with a slashing weapon, one of its extremities is severed. The extremity has AC 15, 10 hit points, a Speed of 10, and the trolls Regeneration trait. The troll controls the severed extremity and perceives through it with the appropriate senses (for instance, it sees through the eyes of its severed head). As a bonus action, the troll can reattach the extremity. While the troll is missing the extremity, its maximum hit points are reduced by 10. Roll d6 to determine the severed extremity:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The troll attacks with its bite and twice with its claw.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The tyrannosaurus makes a bite attack and a tail attack against two different targets.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends  the tyrannosaurus can't bite a different creature and it has advantage on bite attacks against the grappled creature.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

special.name: Good
special.desc: The unicorn radiates a Good aura.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The unicorn attacks once with its hooves and once with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage. If the target is a creature and the unicorn moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage and makes a DC 16 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Grant Boon
actions.desc: The unicorn touches a willing creature  including itself  with its horn and grants one of the following boons:

actions.name: Luck: During the next 24 hours, the creature can roll a d12 and add the result to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw after seeing the result
Protection: A glowing mote of light orbits the creatures head
actions.desc: The mote lasts 24 hours. When the creature fails a saving throw  it can use its reaction to expend the mote and succeed on the saving throw.

actions.name: Resolution: The creature is immune to being charmed or frightened for 24 hours
Healing: The creature magically regains 21 (6d6) hit points
actions.desc: It is cured of all diseases  and poisons affecting it are neutralized.

spells.name: Innate Spellcasting
spells.list: The unicorns innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 16). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:  At Will: Animal Messenger, Detect Evil and Good, Druidcraft, Pass Without Trace, Scrying (locations within its domain only), 1/Day: Calm Emotions, dispel evil and good, Teleport (between locations within its domain only)

name: Ur-Otyugh
languages: telepathy 120 ft. (can transmit but not receive thoughts and images)

special.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
special.desc: If the ur-otyugh fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, it becomes more sluggish. Each time the ur-otyugh uses Legendary Resistance, its Speed and swim speed decrease by 10 and it loses one of its legendary actions on each of its turns.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The otyugh makes two tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.desc: The otyugh slams any creatures it is grappling into a hard surface or into each other. Each creature makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  the target takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage  is stunned until the end of the otyughs next turn  and is pulled up to 5 feet towards the otyugh. On a success  the target takes half damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target contracts a disease. While diseased, the target is poisoned. The target repeats the saving throw every 24 hours, reducing its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) on a failure (to a minimum of 1 hit point) and becoming cured on a success. The reduction in hit points lasts until the disease is cured.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: If the otyugh has no other creature in its stomach, the otyugh bites a Medium or smaller creature that is stunned. On a hit, the creature is swallowed. A swallowed creature has total cover from attacks from outside the otyugh, is blinded and restrained, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the otyugh's turns. If a swallowed creature deals 15 or more damage to the otyugh in a single turn, or if the otyugh dies, the otyugh vomits up the creature.

legendary.name: The ur-otyugh can take 2 legendary actions
legendary.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary.name: Mad Dash
legendary.desc: The ur-otyugh moves up to half its Speed.

legendary.name: Tentacle
legendary.desc: The ur-otyugh makes a tentacle attack. This attack has a range of 15 feet.

legendary.name: Mental Fuzz
legendary.desc: The ur-otyugh transmits a burst of psionic static. Each non-aberration within 30 feet makes a DC 14 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage and is stunned until the end of the ur-otyughs next turn. On a success, the creature takes half damage.
